span.p: readConnection defaults to dbConnection —\nsame connection unless DATABASE_REPLICA_HOST\nis set. See database-scaling.md.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
createUser/updateUser dedupe user_name
via the DB-level unique index, not a
check-then-insert query — catches
ER_DUP_ENTRY from a real insert/update.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p: create() dedupes via a DB-level unique\nindex on (user_id, post_id, comment_hash),\nnot a check-then-insert query.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
Shared helper (datasources/sql/db-errors.ts):
detects mysql2's ER_DUP_ENTRY code so a real
unique-constraint violation can be turned into
a ValidationError instead of a raw DB error.
